1:20 The Midwest is not bound by our silly concepts of borders. It is above of all that. It spans from the Eastern third of the Dakotas, the top half of Missouri, to the Eastern edge of Indiana, to the southern halves of Michigan, Wisconsin, and Minnesota. Western 2/3rds of the Dakotas is "the plains" or just 'the west'. Southern Missouri is the south. p.s. Ohio in not midwest. Whether or not 'the East' accepts them is not my concern. If not, They can be their own thing.
